fusions.name: Hauling Stamp
fusions.desc: A hydraulic hoof stamps the target, which deals 7 damage and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Steam Trample
fusions.desc: Drives a steam-powered trample across a cone 4 tiles long, which deals 26 damage to everything in it. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Draught Harness
fusions.desc: Straps on a braced draught harness that reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Tireless Gearing
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, a reserve flywheel restores 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
